title: Treesa-Gayatri Exit Denmark Open Quarterfinals After Tough Loss
indian_angle: India's promising women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand fought hard but couldn't advance past the quarterfinals.
summary: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand were defeated by Malaysia's second seeds Pearly Tan and Thinaah Muralitharan in the Denmark Open quarterfinals with a score of 21-14, 17-21, 11-21.

title: Suhas LY Kicks Off Asian Para Games with Dominant Win
indian_angle: Indian para-badminton star Suhas LY began his Asian Para Games campaign with a strong victory, raising hopes for a medal.
summary: Indian shuttler Suhas LY secured a winning start in the Asian Para Games badminton event, setting a positive tone for his campaign.

title: Jagsher Khangurra Assures India Medal at Junior Worlds, Reaches Semis
indian_angle: Jagsher Singh Khangurra's advancement to the semifinals guarantees India at least a bronze medal at the BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: Jagsher Singh Khangurra came from behind to defeat Yuan-Syue Jhuang of Chinese Taipei, securing a spot in the semifinals of the Cairo BWF World Junior Championships and assuring India of a medal. He will next face Indonesian Radithya Bayu Wardhana.

title: Treesa-Gayatri Reach Denmark Open Quarterfinals; Srikanth Exits
indian_angle: India's women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand continued their good form by reaching the Denmark Open quarterfinals, while Kidambi Srikanth's run ended.
summary: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand defeated an Indonesian pair 21-16, 21-17 to enter the Denmark Open quarterfinals. Meanwhile, Kidambi Srikanth's campaign in the same tournament concluded.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee provides a crucial platform for Indian badminton players to have a say in the sport's administration and development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at giving players a more direct voice in the governance and decision-making processes within Indian badminton.

title: Junior World Championships Coaching Camp Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: India's top junior shuttlers are undergoing intensive training at the National Centre of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Centre of Excellence (NCE) in Guwahati, bringing together India's promising young badminton talents.
